verdict.rationale: Windmill's flow docs describe branches that split execution based on a condition, plus a 'Branch all' mode that runs every branch, and flows can be built in a low-code builder. That covers conditional and multi-path branching. Explicit filter steps, parallel execution of 'branch all' paths, and merging branches back together are not documented in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented filter steps, explicit confirmation that branch-all paths run in parallel, documented merge/rejoin of branch outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can branch a workflow with conditions, filters, and parallel paths that merge back together

citations.quote: Branches allow to split the execution of the flow based on a condition. ... Branch all: all the branches will be executed.
An orchestrator for assembling these functions into efficient, low-latency flows, using either a low-code builder or YAML
